name: plimsoll
description: Run Python or JavaScript in a plimsoll sandbox and get the isolation tier it ran behind and its checked run record
long_description: plimsoll runs code an AI writes behind a stated isolation boundary. This extension starts the plimsoll MCP server, which sends code to a plimsoll daemon you can reach and returns the output, the isolation tier, and the digest of a run record the client recomputed before accepting the answer; get_record returns the record.

tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Run Python or JavaScript, fresh or in a sandbox from open_sandbox

tools.name: open_sandbox
tools.description: Open a sandbox that keeps files and interpreter state between calls

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: The checked run record of a run_code call

daemon_url.title: plimsolld URL
daemon_url.description: The plimsoll daemon the code runs on, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080. Cleartext HTTP is accepted only to this machine.

token.title: plimsolld caller token
token.description: A caller token with the code:run scope, created with plimsoll-clients.

min_isolation.title: Weakest isolation tier accepted
min_isolation.description: vm, kernel or container. kernel (a verified gVisor runtime) unless you choose otherwise; container for a plain docker daemon, which does not keep hostile code off your kernel.
